responsibility: Defines the ISO fixed-buffer string manipulation interface for gm2. It declares the String1 helper type, procedures for measuring, copying, extracting, deleting, inserting, replacing, appending, and concatenating ARRAY OF CHAR values with ISO truncation-and-terminator semantics, plus preflight capacity predicates and lexical search/comparison utilities such as Compare, FindNext/FindPrev, FindDiff, and Capitalize that higher-level text and conversion modules can use without depending on channel I/O.
same_name_distinction: This .def file is the ISO interface for fixed-buffer ARRAY OF CHAR operations, listing the available constructors, predicates, comparison, and search routines, whereas Strings.mod contains the actual buffer-manipulation algorithms.
